as_told.title: Rogan on a Chinese scientist who vanished

plain: The story is that a Chinese-born physicist named Ning Li did breakthrough work on anti-gravity in the United States, somewhere between the 1990s and 2000s, and then vanished. The researcher Matthew Pines cites her as one of several people doing "breakthrough research on the margins" who then go "poof, they disappear". The comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan, in a clip played on another episode, tells it more loosely as the story of a Chinese scientist working on anti-gravity who vanished, without naming her. If true, it would suggest that people who get close to such technology are taken out of public view.
